title: Consume the canonical tool materialization schema in Vaporize
description: Replace Vaporize's provisional Swift-named materialization record with the released Schema Universal model while preserving its canonical CLI-family naming rules.
acceptanceCriteria: VaporizeProjectModel depends on the v0001_2608_30210 Swift schema projection.
The planner emits tool-materialization-plan-model rather than VaporizeToolMaterializationPlan.
The emitted plan contains neither schemaVersion nor kind.
The existing Digi STUI debug identity remains vaporize.digi-stui-s.v1_2608_30200@wrkstrm-core.coll.
Focused Windows tests and a built CLI proving-ground invocation pass.

evidence.compatibility: The Vaporize public names remain type aliases while the canonical implementation and wire contract are owned by Schema Universal.

resolution: Vaporize now imports and emits the canonical cross-language ToolMaterializationPlanModel.
